content.title: Constructing Jesus: Memory, Imagination, and History
content.author: Dale C. Allison Jr. (Grand Rapids: Baker Academic, 2010)
content.note: Argues from memory studies that the Gospels preserve the general impression ('gist') Jesus left more reliably than individual sayings, and that the criteria cannot do what they promised. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
